Invited speaker for the Emerging Pathogens Institute [Animal Behavior and Infectious Disease Symposium 2026](https://epi.ufl.edu/events/animal-behavior-and-infectious-disease-symposium-2026/) - *When behavior drives extremes: from long-distance seed dispersal to superspreaders* [slide deck](https://javirudolph.github.io/Talks/2026-03-31_seeds_to_superspreaders/index.html#/title-slide)
